attributes.board_name: Connecticut Department of Public Health – Practitioner Licensing and Investigations Section

rules.accepted_credit_types: Workshops or courses (incl. online) and journal studies with content accepted by ASHA, offered by national/state speech-language-hearing associations, regional SLP groups, related professional societies, state and local education agencies, hospitals and health care institutions, accredited colleges and universities. 1 credit per hour of attendance. DPH does not pre-approve courses.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt at the first license renewal until the next registration period.
rules.audit_note: Keep certificates at least 3 years after the year the CE was completed; submit within 45 days of a DPH request.
rules.notes: License renews annually under § 19a-88; at each renewal the licensee must have 20 contact hours within the preceding 24 months, in an area of the licensee's practice. Non-practicing licensees can file a notarized exemption; medical waivers possible. Reinstatement of a void license needs 10 contact hours in the prior year.

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses, workshops, conferences, professional journals and online or in-person activities accepted or approved by national or state audiology organizations or related professional societies; audiology-related graduate coursework at an accredited college. 1 credit per hour of attendance; contact hour = at least 50 minutes.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt at the first license renewal.
rules.audit_note: Keep records at least 3 years after the year the CE was completed; submit within 45 days of a DPH request.
rules.notes: License renews annually under § 19a-88; 20 contact hours within the preceding 24 months, in an area of the licensee's practice. Reinstatement of a void license needs 10 contact hours in the prior year.
